en: A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a tree-lined street leading towards a large, imposing building complex in the background, labeled as 'Kaserne' (German for 'barracks'). The foreground features classic European architecture with ornate facades and gabled roofs. The setting is semi-rural with hills in the distance. The text 'Turnau.' appears in the top left corner, indicating the location.
